# Noiso

> Noiso is an offline sleep sound app for iPhone with seven ambient presets, background audio, and a soft fade-out sleep timer.

Noiso is a one-screen iPhone app focused on calm ambient sleep playback. It has no ads, subscriptions, onboarding, login, or streaming audio.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://noiso.app/): Product overview, interactive demo, and feature summary.
- [Support](https://noiso.app/support/): Playback, timer, background audio, and common support questions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://noiso.app/privacy/): Privacy details and support contact information.

## Key facts

- Works offline with bundled local audio.
- Includes seven ambient presets.
- Supports background playback and lock screen controls in the iPhone app.
- Includes sleep timer options: infinity, 30 minutes, 1 hour, and 2 hours.
- Free to use, with no ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases, or account system.
